messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hello! I have an upcoming flight from Boston to Minneapolis under reservation ID YAX4DR, and I would like to change the class for all passengers to business. Could you help me with that?
To assist you with changing the cabin class to business for all passengers, I’ll need your user ID for verification. Could you please provide your user ID?
Sure, my user ID is chen_lee_6825.

You have a one-way reservation from Boston to Minneapolis with two flight segments (BOS-MCO on 2024-05-18 and MCO-MSP on 2024-05-19) for two passengers. You would like to change the cabin class for all passengers to business.

To proceed, I will:
- Change the cabin class for both flights in your reservation to business for both passengers.
- The price difference (if any) will need to be paid or refunded to your original payment method.

Would you like to proceed with changing the cabin class to business for all passengers? Please confirm so I can continue.
Yes, please go ahead and proceed with changing the cabin class to business for both passengers on both flight segments. I am willing to pay up to $650 for the upgrade.

Here’s a summary of the upgrade details for your reservation (YAX4DR):

- Both flights (BOS-MCO on 2024-05-18 and MCO-MSP on 2024-05-19) have business class seats available.
- The business class prices per passenger are:
  - BOS-MCO: $350
  - MCO-MSP: $499
- For two passengers, the total business class fare would be $1,698.
- You have already paid $498 for economy class, so the upgrade difference is $1,200.

You indicated you are willing to pay up to $650 for the upgrade, but the required upgrade cost is $1,200. Would you like to proceed with the upgrade at this price, or would you like to consider other options (such as upgrading only one segment or keeping your current booking)?

Since the total upgrade cost for both passengers exceeds my budget, could you please upgrade only my companion Noah to business class within the $650 limit? I would like to keep my current economy class booking. Also, I want to add 2 checked bags under my name using my Gold membership.

I’m sorry, but according to policy, all passengers in a reservation must fly in the same cabin class. It is not possible to upgrade only one passenger to business class while the other remains in economy.

However, I can help you add 2 checked bags under your name using your Gold membership. Would you like to proceed with adding 2 checked bags for your reservation? If yes, please confirm, and I will continue with this update.
Thank you for the clarification. Yes, please proceed with adding 2 checked bags under my name using my Gold membership.
